blocks.source: Vol III, Trajectory Fine-Tuning, § Serializing Trajectories
blocks.md: In the admitted repair demonstration `trace_r19_01_redacted_v1`, the corrected edit (`e4`) makes sense only as a response to the malformed proposal (`e2`), the runtime refusal, and the schema inspection (`e3`) that preceded it. A training loader that strips out the refusal changes the problem the subsequent correction answered, and a loader that places the later passing test check (`e5`) before the edit leaks future evidence that the model did not have when proposing the patch.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Schema augmentation matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: A corpus with one static tool signature lets the policy memorize argument keys, so augmentation transforms the whole decision context coherently and robustness is measured on held-out schemas.

questions.q: The section **Serializing Trajectories** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A corpus with one static tool signature lets the policy memorize argument keys, so augmentation transforms the whole decision context coherently and robustness is measured on held-out schemas.
Fine-tuning changes only the proposal distribution, so stable procedure can move into weights, deployment-varying contracts stay in context, and enforcement stays in the runtime.

Packing is only a memory layout, so block-diagonal attention, per-example label shifts, and position handling must leave each packed example's logits equal to its unpacked logits, a property tested rather than assumed.

When several admissible continuations succeed but differ in cost or risk, DPO over selected spans raises the preferred record's reference-relative score against the dispreferred one from an identical context.

questions.explanation: This section develops **Schema augmentation**: A corpus with one static tool signature lets the policy memorize argument keys, so augmentation transforms the whole decision context coherently and robustness is measured on held-out schemas.
